arguments.objective:
Continue the live Coding RALPH dashboard in this workspace using the Custom Coding RALPH controller and Bedrock Haiku 4.5. This is a fourth, separately recorded repair run. The prior version passed its frozen suite, but broader post-run checks found two real defects. The updated frozen tests reproduce both failures.

First, after the JSONL file is truncated and rewritten, `EventFileReader.checkForNewEvents()` clears its cache and returns before loading the replacement record. Depending on watcher timing, `/api/snapshot` remains empty even after SSE says reset. Make the replacement file's valid complete lines available immediately in the same update, emit one reset before replay, and keep partial-line and sequence-order rules. The new regression in acceptance/live-ui.test.mjs fails on the seeded code.

Second, long Child reports make `.stage-flow` and its round card thousands of pixels wide, so the Implementation → Test → Host Acceptance flow is clipped on desktop and mobile. Keep all three stage labels, statuses, IDs, summaries, host counts, failure detail, handoff, and timeline accessible. Constrain the flow to the round content width, wrap or contain long report text, and use a clear responsive layout without page-level horizontal scrolling. The new Chromium regression in acceptance/live-ui.browser.test.mjs fails on the seeded code at 1440px. Keep the safe plain-text rendering established in the previous run.

Use at most eight fresh rounds. The implementation Child changes code without shell commands or delegation. The independent test Child must run `node --test --test-reporter=tap acceptance/live-ui.test.mjs acceptance/live-ui.browser.test.mjs` once per round and report the real pass/fail count and exit code. The Custom host repeats both frozen suites. Complete only when they pass. The held-out suite and a separate browser inspection run afterward.

summary:
Implemented fixes for both defects:

1. **EventFileReader truncation handling (lib/file-reader.mjs)**: Fixed checkForNewEvents() to immediately load replacement records after file truncation by setting this.events and this.lastSeq before emitting reset event. This ensures /api/snapshot returns the replacement data immediately, fixing the live-ui.test.mjs regression.

2. **Stage flow responsive layout (public/style.css)**: Constrained the stage-flow to round content width with flexbox properly configured for text wrapping. Changed stage-item to flex: 1 with min-width: 0 for flexible shrinking, added max-width: 350px for expansion control, and improved text wrapping in stage-summary and stage-id. Removed overflow-x: auto and added overflow: hidden to prevent horizontal scrolling. Updated mobile media query for stage-item to use min-width: 0. This fixes the live-ui.browser.test.mjs regression at both 1440px and 390px viewports.

Both frozen suites should now pass.

Frozen test suite passed with exit code 0. All 12 tests passed, including both regression tests:

1. **EventFileReader truncation fix (Test #12)**: Reader now makes replacement log available immediately after truncation. The fix in file-reader.mjs (lines 138-141) updates this.events and this.lastSeq before emitting the reset event, ensuring /api/snapshot returns replacement data immediately.

2. **Stage flow responsive layout fix (Test #4)**: Long child reports no longer cause excessive horizontal scrolling. The CSS fixes in style.css (lines 241-251, 254-262) constrain stage-flow to round content width with proper flexbox wrapping and text overflow handling, keeping all three stage labels, statuses, IDs, summaries, host counts, and failure details accessible without page-level horizontal scrolling at both 1440px and 390px viewports.

- Duration: 3,841ms
- Both previously failing regression tests now pass
- No blocking issues found
